n, K, mod = map(int, input().split())

def power(x, y):
    ret = 1
    while y:
        if y & 1:
            ret = (ret * x) % mod
        x = (x * x) % mod
        y >>= 1
    return ret

def C(i, j):
    return (cj[i] * inv[j] % mod) * inv[i - j] % mod

# Read input
# n, K, mod are already read above

if n & 1:
    print(power(K, n))
    exit()

cj = [1] * (n + 1)
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    cj[i] = (cj[i - 1] * i) % mod

inv = [1] * (n + 1)
inv[n] = power(cj[n], mod - 2)
for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
    inv[i] = (inv[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % mod

cnt = [0] * (n + 1)
mx = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(19):
        if (1 << j) & i:
            cnt[i] += 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in reversed(range(19)):
        if (1 << j) & i:
            mx[i] = 1 << j
            break

dp = [[0] * (K + 2) for _ in range(n + 1)]
dp[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if (n & i) != i:
        continue
    now = i ^ mx[i]
    k = now
    while True:
        cur1 = k + mx[i]
        cur2 = i ^ cur1
        up = min(K - 1, cnt[cur2])
        tmp = C(i, cur1)
        for j in range(up + 1):
            dp[i][j + 1] = (dp[i][j + 1] + dp[cur2][j] * tmp) % mod
        if k == 0:
            break
        k = (k - 1) & now

ans = 0
for j in range(1, min(cnt[n], K) + 1):
    ans = (ans + dp[n][j] * C(K, j) % mod * cj[j]) % mod

ans = (power(K, n) - ans + mod) % mod
print(ans)
